title: Micro-Mobility Services: Cayman Islands deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: No income tax, so costs sit in duty, licence fees, rent and pay. Work out landed cost for every item. Check with a local expert.
Collect only trip data you need: start, end, time, payment. State why and how long you keep it.
Add tax and duty explicitly; never bury them in a price. Check with a local expert.
Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit for vertical farming and ghost kitchens: imported food is costly and land is limited.

Cluster F, Food and farming: Strong fit for vertical farming and ghost kitchens: imported food is costly and land is limited.
Many workers are on work permits; hiring rules favour local hiring, so check them. Check with a local expert.
A monthly review: what we planned, what happened, what we change.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Say in plain words what you collect and why; give a way to see and correct it.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.

One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Name partners: repair shops, charging hosts, the city office, local shops for stands.
Pension and health-insurance contributions apply to staff; check the rates and budget them.
Check city permits, parking zones, speed limits, helmet and age rules, and insurance before any vehicle is out. Check with a local expert.
Show proof: ride counts, safety record and a short rider survey.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Small market: one strong niche beats a broad range. Word of mouth is powerful.
Launch with a go or no-go rule: 3 rides per bike per day for 4 weeks and a margin above 20%. Check with a local expert.
Many customers are overseas finance and tourism clients: keep a list of every place customer data goes.
Cluster H, People and business support: Coaching, coworking and outsourcing fit a finance-led island with many small advisers.
